scripts.build:studio: cd sanity && npm run build && cp -r dist ../dist/admin && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const f='../dist/admin/index.html'; let h=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'); h=h.replace(/\"\/static\//g,'\"/admin/static/'); fs.writeFileSync(f,h);"
scripts.build:routes: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('dist/_routes.json')); r.exclude.push('/admin/*'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/_routes.json', JSON.stringify(r,null,2));"
scripts.build: npm run build:app && npm run build:studio && npm run build:routes
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=fairbanks-shakespeare --branch=development
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=fairbanks-shakespeare --branch=main
